Release History

v1.1.9

What's new and improved:

  • Export portable, encrypted backups and preview them before restoring on another device.
  • Load older messages in your conversations; message notifications and deep links are now more reliable.
  • Improved data integrity across pair, incubation, egg, and chick records, plus a smoother, more responsive calendar.
  • Stabilized Premium plans, purchases, restores, and subscription activation.
  • Improved accessibility, performance, and overall app stability.

Thanks for your feedback!

v1.1.8

What's new and improved:

  • Database and sync stability were improved when upgrading from older versions.
  • Community posting and full-size image moderation are now more reliable.
  • Premium access, genetics calculations, and notification scheduling performance were improved.
  • Admin roles, error reporting, security, and accessibility issues were fixed.

Thanks for your feedback!

v1.1.7

What's new and improved:

  • Daily streaks and their reminders are now more reliable.
  • Linkage phase controls and more accurate outcomes were added to the genetics calculator.
  • Corrupted backups and incorrect passwords now produce clearer restore messages.
  • Messaging, follow state, account recovery, and Premium access issues were fixed.
  • Notification accessibility, localization, and overall app security were improved.

Thanks for your feedback!

Thanks for your feedback!

v1.0.0

  • Manage birds, breeding pairs, incubations, eggs, and chicks in one place.
